beats.line: sitting in the middle of absolutely nowhere. And once you find the entrance
there is absolutely no warm-up. You begin the level
by rappelling down a pitch-black vertical drop
but this is just the beginning as the cave will spam vertical drops back to back
taking you deeper and deeper into the complex limestone system
as you continue to work your way down the temperatures will very quickly drop
and you're freezing and the humidity will skyrocket to one hundred percent
to make things more interesting the limestone walls and floors are extremely slippery
adding some much needed comedic relief to your slow descent into panic
but as you work your way from camp one, two, three, four, and finally camp five
